parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
Language type of the returned information:

- zh: Chinese
- en: English

parameters.name: Beta
parameters.description:
Whether it is a Beta release.

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse get-nacos-config --instance-id mse-cn-i7m2h00000 --data-id halvie-mp-item0000 --group common --namespace-id ddaf8f12-0000-b1c1-86e7c72e266b --beta true --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse GetNacosConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Group common --DataId 'halvie-mp-item0000' --InstanceId 'mse-cn-i7m2h00000' --AcceptLanguage zh --NamespaceId 'ddaf8f12-0000-b1c1-86e7c72e266b' --Beta true
